prompt: Use case: stylized-concept. Paint a polished landscape concept reference sheet, roughly 1600px wide, for a cozy Genshin-like browser RPG. Cream parchment, warm painterly light, lavender shadows, generous legible labels. Ancient Hearth limestone #DEC398, highlights #F4DEB2, shade #9C91A7; broad rounded ashlar, shallow leaf carving; aged brass #B58C47, sage moss #89936B, ochre roots #98613C, tiny teal #648F88 accents. Gold glow only in active channels. Friendly ancient engineering, no grimdark or monsters, no modern technology. Hero is a brown-haired youth in tan shirt, dark trousers, boots, 1.8 blocks tall. Title: SLUICE KEEPER. A large gearling, compact wheeled ancient maintenance machine with honey stone armored shell, two large paddle-rim drive wheels, brass axle and valve, single inset lume lens. 3.2 blocks tall, 4 blocks wide, 3 deep. Upper row large consistent FRONT, SIDE, BACK orthographic turnarounds plus hero with dimension ruler. Back clearly shows exposed axle weak point. Bottom three attack-rule drawings: CHARGE TELL (wheels wind back, lens brightens, straight lane marked); FLOOD CHANNEL (hero pulls sluice lever, water fills wheel trench); STALLED (wheels submerged, back axle exposed, hero strikes). Palette labeled stone/brass/lume/water/slate. Small silhouette at sprite size. No humanoid warrior.

Revision: Edit this reference sheet, preserve design, turnarounds, pose panels, dimensions, palette and layout.
